Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All trolleys are baskets.

Some briefcase are trolleys.

**Conclusions:**

I. All briefcase are baskets.

II. Some basket are briefcases.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
As per the given statements, the least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3ae79a9d57ede273857eb29c7c0a48731c37d8c9d161c13039977c067dc19e6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45ee36cce13beb172974b3289aa66f9af4e883f5a06795d44765aa003ce5644e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All briefcases are baskets. → N**ot follow** (All trolleys are baskets, and some briefcases are trolleys. which means only some briefcases are baskets)

II. Some baskets are briefcases. →** Follow** (All trolleys are baskets, and some briefcases are trolleys, which means some baskets are briefcases)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**

questions.question:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

7 and 4

I. 7 × 8 + 4 - 9 ÷ 3 = 30

II. 9 + 4 × 8 ÷ 2 - 7 = 33
questions.solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

**Given equations:**

**I. 7 × 8 + 4 - 9 ÷ 3 = 30**

After interchanging 7 and 4 in equation (I):

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 4 × 8 + 7 - __**9 ÷ 3**__

⇒ __**4 × 8**__ + 7 - 3

⇒ 32 + 7 - 3 = 36

Here, the equation (I) is not satisfied.

**II. 9 + 4 × 8 ÷ 2 - 7 = 33**

After interchanging 7 and 4 in equation (II):

⇒ 9 + 7 × __**8 ÷ 2**__ - 4

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 9 + __**7 × 4**__ - 4

⇒ __**9 + 28**__ - 4

⇒ 37 - 4 = 33

⇒ LHS = RHS

Here, the **equation (II)** is **satisfied.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only II****".**

questions.question:
Which of the mathematical signs should be interchanged in the below equation to make it mathematically correct?

45 - 6 + 108 ÷ 12 × 14 = 5
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

Given:

⇒ 45 - 6 + 108 ÷ 12 × 14 = 5

(1) **÷ and -**

⇒ 45 - 6 + 108 ÷ 12 × 14

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ __**45 ÷ 6**__ + 108 - 12 × 14

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 7.5 + 108 - __**12 × 14**__

⇒ __**7.5 + 108**__ - 168

⇒ 115.5 - 168

⇒ (-52.5)

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) **× and -**

⇒ 45 - 6 + 108 ÷ 12 × 14 = 5

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 46 × 6 + __**108 ÷ 12** __- 14

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**46 × 6**__ + 9 - 14

⇒ __**276 + 9**__ - 14

⇒ 285 - 14 = 271

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(3) **+ and ×**

⇒ 45 - 6 + 108 ÷ 12 × 14 = 5

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 45 - 6 ×__** 108 ÷ 12**__ + 14

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 45 - __**6 × 9**__ + 14

⇒ 45 - 54 + 14

⇒ 59 - 54 = **5**

⇒ LHS = RHS

⇒ **45 - 6 × 108 ÷ 12 + 14 = 5**

Here, the equation is **satisfied.**

(4) **+ and -**

⇒ 45 - 6 + 108 ÷ 12 × 14 = 5

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 45 + 6 - __**108 ÷ 12**__ × 14

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 45 + 6 - __**9 × 14**__

⇒ 45 + 6 - 126

⇒ 51 - 126

⇒ (-75)

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "**+ and ×**".
